title: Mawonekedwe a pulatifomu
requiredTextNote: Ma tag ena a malemba ndi ofunikira ndipo amakhala oyatsidwa nthawi zonse (akuwonetsedwa ngati ozimitsidwa).
featuresWarning: Kuzimitsa zosankha izi kungachotse kuthekera kwakukulu kolemba ndi koyang'anira.
largeSiteWarning: Tsamba ili lili ndi masamba ambiri. Kupanga chigoba kungatenge nthawi.
skeletonLargeSiteConfirm: Webusayiti iyi ili ndi masamba {count}. Kupanga mafupa kungatenge nthawi ndikupanga fayilo yaikulu. Pitirizani?
toolbarPreviewAlt: Chithunzithunzi cha bala la zida zosinthira la {audience}
addPageFeatureDescription: Imalola kupanga masamba atsopano kuchokera ku bala la pamwamba, zochita za ndondomeko, ndi zochita zosaka malamulo.
deletePageFeatureDescription: Imalola kuchotsa masamba kuchokera ku zochita za tsamba, zochita za ndondomeko, ndi njira zina za woyang'anira.
outlineDesignerFeatureDescription: Imayatsa zida za kapangidwe ka webusayiti, kuphatikizapo zochita za ndondomeko ndi ntchito za woyang'anira za Kapangidwe.
styleGuideFeatureDescription: Imaonetsa kufikira kwa Kalozera wa Kalembedwe m'zida za woyang'anira ndi njira zachidule zosaka malamulo.
insightsFeatureDescription: Imayatsa Malipoti mwa woyang'anira ndi kusaka malamulo kuti mawonekedwe a ziwerengero ndi kumvetsetsa apezeke.
siteManifestFeatureDescription: Imawongolera magawo a Zokonda za Webusayiti a Zambiri, Zipika, ndi kakonzedwe ka Mkonzi.
themeManifestFeatureDescription: Imayatsa gawo la zokonda za Maonekedwe/Mawonekedwe mu kuyang'anira webusayiti.
authorManifestFeatureDescription: Imayatsa mbiri ya wolemba ndi zokonda za zambiri za wolemba mu kuyang'anira webusayiti.
seoManifestFeatureDescription: Imayatsa zokonda za injini zosakira ndi kukonza zambiri za tsamba mu kuyang'anira webusayiti.
pageBreakFeatureDescription: Imaonetsa zowongolera kusintha zambiri za tsamba monga mutu, chizindikiro, mkhalidwe, ma tag, ndi kutseka.
addBlockFeatureDescription: Imaonetsa msakatuli wa zipika ndipo imalola kuonjezera zipika zatsopano pamene mukusintha.
popularGizmosFeatureDescription: Imaonetsa gawo la zipika Zotchuka mkati mwa wosankha zipika.
recentGizmosFeatureDescription: Imaonetsa gawo la zipika Zaposachedwa mkati mwa wosankha zipika.
contentMapFeatureDescription: Imaonetsa gulu la mapu/kapangidwe ka zomwe zili m'tsamba pamene mukusintha.
viewSourceFeatureDescription: Imayatsa mawonekedwe a gwero la HTML kuti musinthe ma code a tsamba mwachindunji.
uploadMediaFeatureDescription: Imayatsa njira zokwezera mafayilo ndi kufikira kwa kuyang'anira zofalitsa/mafayilo.
onlineMediaFeatureDescription: Imayatsa kulumikizana kwa zofalitsa za pa intaneti ndi magwero osakira zofalitsa zakutali.
communityFeatureDescription: Imayatsa nkhani zosaka malamulo zokhudza gulu ndi zochita zofikira anthu.
